findings.title: Timing bound in the load test may be jitter-sensitive on slow CI runners
findings.description: Task 22a seeds "a few hundred" run-state files and asserts wall-clock under `MAX_LISTING_S = 1.0`, citing the design's target (measured 0.67 s for 188 runs). The bound is the design's own NFR so the task is correctly scoped, but a few hundred files on a cold CI runner is close to the limit; if flakiness shows up in practice, the fix is seeding nearer the design's measurement scale or counting reads rather than only wall-clock. No action required at breakdown time.

findings.title: Task 5's grep success criterion depends on Task 6
findings.description: Task 5's success check ("`grep -rn "on_step_complete\|make_step_callback" src tests` is empty after Task 6") is satisfied only once the test migration in Task 6 lands. This is explicit and harmless, but the check belongs logically with Task 7's commit point; a junior executor should treat it as verified at Task 7, not Task 5. Informational only.
